create.name: Vicky Carter
create.bio:
Vicky Carter is a Reiki Master Teacher in Harborne, Birmingham, who has worked with people one to one since the late 1990s. She was already practising as a counsellor when she received her first Reiki attunement in 2003, an experience she describes as opening a gentler, more spiritual side of her work, and she went on through each degree to become a Reiki Master Teacher in 2007. She teaches in the Usui Shiki Ryoho system and holds the Reiki principles as a daily discipline as well as a method of hands-on healing.

From her room in Harborne she gives Reiki sessions in person and sends distance Reiki by arrangement, and she trains students through First, Second and Third Degree to Master Teacher level in small weekend groups of about six. Her calendar also includes a monthly evening of yoga nidra, full-day yoga nidra and chakra workshops, and day retreats on sensing subtle energy and on slowing down, most with an organic lunch. Her background in counselling, including years in schools, a hospice and a secure hospital, shapes the calm, unhurried way she holds a group, though her therapy services are not part of this listing.

courses.title: First Degree Reiki
courses.description: A two-day weekend introduction to Usui Reiki for up to six people, with attunements, hands-on practice in giving and receiving, and time for meditation and reflection. No previous experience is needed; several weekends a year.

courses.title: Second Degree Reiki
courses.description: Two days on the Reiki symbols, distant healing and working with the chakras, leading to practitioner level. Open to students at least six months after their First Degree.

courses.title: Third Degree Reiki – Reiki Master
courses.description: The Master attunement over one weekend in a group of six, with heart-centred meditations, shared practice and teaching on offering Reiki at times of grief and at the end of life. Requires First and Second Degree, with six months since the second.

courses.title: Reiki Master Teacher Training
courses.description: Individual mentoring for Reiki Masters who want to teach and attune others, shaped around each student's pace. Dates and fees are agreed after an initial conversation.

courses.title: Reiki Energy Healing sessions
courses.description: Hands-on Usui Reiki in her quiet treatment room in Harborne, aimed at deep rest, balance and a clearer mind. Sessions run for 75 or 90 minutes.

courses.title: Distance Reiki Healing
courses.description: Reiki sent at an agreed time to you or to someone you name, wherever they are, with the choice of staying on a video call or resting privately. A short conversation afterwards is offered.

courses.title: Monthly Yoga Nidra – Deep Rest & Relaxation
courses.description: An hour of guided yoga nidra in a small group on the first Wednesday evening of each month. You lie down and are led into deep, aware rest; no yoga experience is needed.

courses.title: Yoga Nidra Workshop
courses.description: A full Saturday for six people given over to yoga nidra, breath work, visualisation and setting an intention. Held on several dates through the year.

courses.title: Chakra Cleansing & Energy Flow Workshop
courses.description: A day exploring the seven main chakras through meditation and energy practices, with a light organic lunch, for up to eight people. Runs on more than one Saturday a year.

courses.title: Awakening Your Inner Awareness
courses.description: An experiential day retreat on noticing subtle energy, trusting intuition, and grounding and protecting your own energy, opening with a grounding meditation. Eight places, vegetarian organic lunch included.
